questions.question: How does Jeremiah 10 describe idols?
options: Like faithful shepherds leading their flocks to good pasture
Like scarecrows in a cucumber field; they cannot speak or walk
Like watchful watchmen guarding the great gates of the city
Like mighty and exalted kings seated high on their golden thrones
questions.answer: Like scarecrows in a cucumber field; they cannot speak or walk

questions.question: In contrast, how is the LORD described in Jeremiah 10?
options: A lifeless idol of silver and beaten gold
A distant maker unknown to the peoples of earth
The greatest among all the many gods of the nations
The true God, the living God, the everlasting King
questions.answer: The true God, the living God, the everlasting King

questions.question: Jeremiah 10 says the LORD made the earth by his power and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.
Their idols are like _____ in a cucumber field, and they cannot speak.
The LORD is the true God; he is the living God and the everlasting _____.
